content.text: {"sections":[{"section":"summary","body":"Mosswell Robotics is compliant with each of its covenants on the Venture Term Loan for the period ended October 31, 2026. The compliance certificate agrees with the bank's calculations on every covenant. The main change is in the Minimum Unrestricted Cash covenant: its cushion has narrowed steadily since August and stands at {{fact:08c4c464-d664-4f78-b775-4e9c2eaebc21}} in October, which points to ongoing cash burn. There is no breach and no open work item, so nothing requires a decision this period. The cash trend is worth watching in coming periods."},{"section":"covenants","body":"Minimum Runway is compliant. The bank calculated {{fact:18b6042d-478b-458b-89df-9a3e6ea857ea}} against a required {{fact:d8e7a08e-b4ba-4047-9e03-1b86bf148d68}}, a cushion of {{fact:a104692c-28b5-4d71-bdd1-f0ef07cd65ab}}. Minimum Unrestricted Cash is compliant at {{fact:6ac67879-e877-4543-a08b-598cab953c80}} against a floor of {{fact:ddd5737d-8265-4ee1-b8d0-1de5eff6213f}}, a cushion of {{fact:08c4c464-d664-4f78-b775-4e9c2eaebc21}}. Revenue to Plan is compliant at {{fact:d54790d7-ccf2-40a6-9bf8-591067ae3226}} against a required {{fact:74092bbc-83f4-41de-b9d8-2ebb3e612cf7}}, a cushion of {{fact:22b73e72-96b2-4f32-b2ca-b509f16a22c5}}. The certificate figures match the bank's calculations on all covenants: runway {{fact:5b0801ff-3e3e-4133-8f11-28a19289bdaf}}, cash {{fact:333a299e-87c8-4b81-bfe4-b6e355ed12fc}} and revenue to plan {{fact:2242b687-ed47-4d7b-ac8c-9798ab0603f6}}."},{"section":"risks","body":"One low-severity signal fired: covenant headroom falling on Minimum Unrestricted Cash. The cushion has narrowed in each month from August through October and is now {{fact:08c4c464-d664-4f78-b775-4e9c2eaebc21}}. Cash of {{fact:6ac67879-e877-4543-a08b-598cab953c80}} remains above the {{fact:ddd5737d-8265-4ee1-b8d0-1de5eff6213f}} floor, so the concern is the direction rather than the level. No other signal fired to confirm or explain the trend, and no work items are open. A reviewer may want to check whether the reported runway is consistent with the recent rate of cash decline."}]}
